_note: Built by engine/breeding/stock.py pack_from_db from PokeAPI's CSVs (pokeref.sqlite). learn[vg][L|E|T|M|B][species]: level-up as [move, level, …] in learning order; egg, tutor, machine and Light Ball moves as move ids.

crystal.ivs: DVs: the egg takes its Defense DV from the parent of the opposite sex (or Ditto), and its Special DV too half the time (otherwise Special ±8). Attack and Speed are random; HP follows from the others.

firered.ivs: Three different stats are inherited, each from a parent chosen at random: any one stat 1 in 2, from the parent you want 1 in 4.
firered.nature: Random (1 in 25): FireRed has no Everstone inheritance.
firered.ability: Not inherited in Gens 3-4: an egg gets one of its species' abilities at random (1 in 2 when it has two).

emerald.ivs: Three draws, each from a random parent; the second can't be HP and the third can't be HP or Defense, and a later draw can land on the same stat (pokeplatinum Egg_InheritIVs): HP 1 in 6, Defense 1 in 3, the rest 1 in 2; from the parent you want, half that.
emerald.nature: The mother (or Ditto) holding an Everstone passes her nature half the time: 52% in all, 1 in 25 without.
emerald.ability: Not inherited in Gens 3-4: an egg gets one of its species' abilities at random (1 in 2 when it has two).

platinum.ivs: Three draws, each from a random parent; the second can't be HP and the third can't be HP or Defense, and a later draw can land on the same stat (pokeplatinum Egg_InheritIVs): HP 1 in 6, Defense 1 in 3, the rest 1 in 2; from the parent you want, half that.
platinum.nature: The mother (or Ditto) holding an Everstone passes her nature half the time: 52% in all, 1 in 25 without. Platinum: only if both parents come from games of the same language.
platinum.ability: Not inherited in Gens 3-4: an egg gets one of its species' abilities at random (1 in 2 when it has two).

heartgold.ivs: Three different stats, each from a random parent: any one stat 1 in 2, from the parent you want 1 in 4. A parent holding a Power item always passes that stat; then two of the other five (2 in 5 each).
heartgold.nature: Either parent holding an Everstone passes its nature half the time: 52% in all, 1 in 25 without.
heartgold.ability: Not inherited in Gens 3-4: an egg gets one of its species' abilities at random (1 in 2 when it has two).

soulsilver.ivs: Three different stats, each from a random parent: any one stat 1 in 2, from the parent you want 1 in 4. A parent holding a Power item always passes that stat; then two of the other five (2 in 5 each).
soulsilver.nature: Either parent holding an Everstone passes its nature half the time: 52% in all, 1 in 25 without.
soulsilver.ability: Not inherited in Gens 3-4: an egg gets one of its species' abilities at random (1 in 2 when it has two).

how.default: knows it at hatch (a level-up move by Lv {lvl})
how.egg: an egg move: the father knows it
how.tm: the father knows it, and the egg can learn that TM/HM
how.shared: both parents know it, and the egg learns it by level-up
how.light-ball: a parent holds a Light Ball
